name: switch
title: Switch
description: A pearl thumb that slides onto ink for settings that apply at once.
use: A setting that is on or off and takes effect immediately, without a save button.

instead.when: The choice is submitted with a form
The setting needs a title and a sentence of its own
It picks one of a few options instead of on or off

keyboard.action: Toggles the switch, as the native checkbox does

classes.name: switch
classes.description: A native checkbox with role="switch": a track 22px tall with a thumb 3px inside it

states.name: on
states.description: The track fills with ink and the thumb slides to the end

example:
<label class="check">
  <input type="checkbox" role="switch" class="switch" checked>
  Email notifications
</label>
